observation: Within this curated dataset, 11 ASD variants were assigned: ANK repeats 6/11 (54.5%), ZU5 1 4/11 (36.4%), UPA 1/11 (9.1%); all 11 assigned. Individual sites: ANK 2 (Asn63_Lys95del), ANK 11 (Ala368Gly consistent with disrupting NrCAM binding, Ala373Val increased NrCAM affinity ~1.7x), ANK 15 (Ala525Val), ANK 24 (Ile807Met, Glu819Lys), ZU5 1 (Arg977Gln, Arg987Trp, Arg1003Ter, Arg1138Ter), UPA (Pro1380Arg).
interpretation: Healthy-channel widths aside, ASD variants distribute across the ankyrin-repeat array with a secondary ZU5-1 cluster.
limitation: Small curated sample (n=11); assignments depend on the Step-3 feature map; Pro1380Arg is de novo in UPA region per source paper, not impaired for beta2-spectrin binding, stability-tested (reduced ~60% WT).

observation: Exploratory Step-7 Fisher test, ANK repeats vs non-ANK broad class: ASD 6/5 vs Cardiac 0/9; two-sided P=0.0141; one-sided P=0.0119; OR=Inf (zero cell; Haldane-0.5 CI [1.05, 479.96]). Across 5 tested categories, Bonferroni α=0.010; the ANK-repeats p=0.0141 does NOT survive multiple-testing correction and is not significant here. Reported as exploratory only.
interpretation: The available evidence is consistent with an ankyrin-repeat concentration of curated ASD variants, but this is exploratory and not causal.
limitation: Small samples; 5/9 cardiac variants unassigned and excluded from the ANK-vs-non-ANK coding; OR undefined due to a zero cell; result is post-hoc and sensitive to coding; not multiple-testing-significant.

observation: ANK2 is a known rare-variant risk gene for ASD and NDD: ASD_FDR0.05=1 and NDD_FDR0.05=1 in the Demontis 2025 ST4 flags; ANK2 PPI union is enriched for ASD/DD rare-variant risk genes (ASD KS P=7.926e-7, FDR 1.902e-6; DD P=1e-15).
interpretation: The evidence provides gene-level and interactome-level overlap of ANK2 with ASD/NDD risk biology; ANK2 is a genuine cross-disorder risk gene.
limitation: Enrichments are network-level and do not localize a residue or domain within ANK2.

observation: ASD_missense Arg977Gln (ZU5A subdomain, within ZU5 1) is consistent with disrupting beta2-spectrin binding and reducing stability (model + co-IP; residue falls in PDB 6M3Q 951-1458); Ala368Gly is consistent with disrupting NrCAM binding (pocket in ANK repeat 11).
column8: A documented ASD missense sits in an ANK2 spectrin-interaction region; functional disruption is assayed in heterologous systems.
column9: Functional consequences measured in vitro/in cells, not disease; do not generalize from single variants to disease mechanism; unrelated to ADHD evidence.

observation: 9 curated Cardiac P/LP ClinVar variants: assigned to ZU5 1 (Glu1091fs, n=1), UPA (Ala1405fs, n=1), Disordered (Gln3076Ter, Asp3081fs, n=2); 5 unassigned (Glu3525Ter, Ser3713Ala, Arg3113Ter, Lys1631fs, splice c.1485+1G>A).
domain_or_region: ZU5 1; UPA; Disordered; no Step-3 feature (1631-3713)
interpretation: Cardiac variants localize sparsely across ZU5-1/UPA with several truncations in the C-terminal region that the Step-3 feature map does not annotate.
limitation: 5/9 unassigned because the feature map does not cover all canonical residues; do not retrospectively assign them; small sample.

observation: 7/9 curated cardiac variants are truncation-type (3 nonsense, 3 frameshift, 1 splice); onset positions span UPA (1405) through the C-terminal tail (1631, 3525, 3713, 3076, 3081, 3113).
domain_or_region: UPA (1289-1423) to C-terminal tail (no Step-3 feature)
interpretation: Truncation-onset positions are spread across the middle and C-terminal portions, consistent with loss-of-function and consistent with known cardiac ankyrin-B biology.
limitation: No functional assay in this project; unassigned positions carry no domain claim; this cardiac pattern is not evidence of an ANK2 neuronal excitability mechanism.

observation: ANK2 is an exome-wide-significant ADHD rare-variant risk gene: P(final) combined class I+II gene burden = 2.273e-6; OR(combined class I) = 5.55; pLI = 1.0. Channelopathy gene-set enrichment among top-20 ADHD risk genes: 4/55 overlap (incl. ANK2, KCNA2, CACNA1D); corrected P = 2.43e-4.
interpretation: The evidence provides a robust gene-level ADHD association for ANK2, alongside gene-set-level channelopathy enrichment among ADHD risk genes.
limitation: Gene-level only; no individual ADHD ANK2 protein coordinates are curated in this project; channelopathy enrichment is gene-set-level and does not establish an ANK2 excitation mechanism.

observation: Class I (rPTV): 11 iPSYCH ADHD cases / 12 combined controls; P(combined c1)=1.204e-4; OR=5.55. Class II (rModerateDMV): 3 cases / 0 controls; P(combined c2)=2.858e-3; OR=Inf. Mixed class I + class II burden is described as distinct from MAP1A and ANO8 (class I only).
domain_or_region: allelic class, not residue or domain
interpretation: The ADHD burden is driven by protein-truncating plus moderately damaging missense variants, consistent with strong constraint and loss-of-function.
limitation: Variant-class evidence says nothing about where within ANK2 the relevant variants fall; class II has zero control carriers.

observation: 11 ANK2 class I carriers (Supp Fig 5): 1 control; 7 ADHD-only; 2 ADHD+ID; 1 ADHD+ASD+SZ+ID. Discussion states the signal was 'driven mainly' by ADHD with co-occurring ASD/ID (qualitative).
interpretation: The ADHD rare-variant signal overlaps carriers with comorbid ASD/ID, consistent with ANK2's known cross-disorder role.
limitation: Small counts read from a figure; qualitative direction only; comorbidity does not localize the signal within ANK2.

observation: ANK2_Union = 158 genes (NPC 76, ExN 108, overlap 26; NPC-only 50, ExN-only 82); flags from published IP-MS (Table S2 of ref 27), not a new experiment.
interpretation: The PPI evidence is primarily network-level: bait membership per gene, not residue-level interaction information.
limitation: Membership is protein-level; no per-interactor fold-change/FDR for ANK2 is present in the source workbook.

observation: ANK2_Union enrichments: actin cytoskeleton GO:0015629 corrected P=2.77e-39 (51/517); cell junction GO:0030054 corrected P=1.17e-30 (78/2241); actin binding GO:0003779 corrected P=6.79e-28 (40/446).
interpretation: The ANK2 interactome is strongly enriched for actin/cytoskeletal and junction annotations.
limitation: Gene-set enrichment; annotations describe interactor functions, not ANK2 domains.

observation: SynGO: 70/158 (44.30%) of ANK2_Union map to synaptic annotations; synapse GO:0045202 corrected P=1.52e-29 (67/1478).
interpretation: Synaptic enrichment is consistent with a cytoskeletal/synaptic convergence at the level of the ANK2 interactome.
limitation: Does not establish where in ANK2 any synaptic function arises.

observation: SPTBN1 (beta-2-spectrin): explicit ANK2 interaction interval 966-1125 (UniProt REGION 'Interaction with SPTBN1'; JBC 2025 SBD definition), overlapping Step-3 ZU5 1 (968-1156).
interpretation: Localization evidence for the PPI network is limited to this explicit interval; high confidence; not all of ZU5 1 is claimed as interface.
limitation: Single interactor; interval from literature curations rather than a domain-wide PPI measurement.

observation: L1CAM: explicit ankyrin-repeat 11-14 localization (MBD site-3; Chen 2017 eLife; Wang 2014), repeat-level only; no residue interval assigned.
interpretation: Localization evidence is limited to repeat-level for L1CAM; the residue-level interface is not resolved for L1CAM itself.
limitation: Medium confidence; Chirasani R11-pocket validation applies to NrCAM, not L1CAM; only 2/158 interactors map.

observation: 156/158 ANK2_Union members have no explicit ANK2 localization evidence and are marked not_mappable (not assigned to any domain).
interpretation: The PPI evidence is primarily network-level, with very limited residue/domain-level localization (2/158).
limitation: The 156 not_mappable must not be treated as a domain; no enrichment statistic is computed from this subset.

observation: No full-length experimental ANK2 structure; no canonical Q01484 AlphaFold model identified; experimental structures cover the ANK-repeat array (e.g., 4RLV 28-873), ZU5-ZU5-UPA-DD (4D8O 966-1210/1253-1568; 6M3Q 951-1458 with beta-IV-spectrin), LIR 1588-1614 (5YIR/5YIS), DD 1499-1570 (6KZJ); canonical residues 1873-3957 lack an identified canonical model.
interpretation: Structure coverage contextualizes variant and domain mapping but does not itself localize function; isoform-only AlphaFold models are not canonical Q01484 coverage.
limitation: Missing structure does not imply disorder; absence of a model is not evidence of absence of structure.

observation: No curated observation in this dataset connects ANK2 to both cytoskeletal/synaptic and excitability/channel biology at a single domain or residue.
column8: The available data do not establish an intersectional mechanism at domain level; channelopathy overlap is gene-set-level and PPI/cytoskeletal enrichment is network-level.
column9: Absence of intersectional evidence is a limitation, not evidence against such a mechanism; no hypothesis test was performed.

observation: No individual ADHD ANK2 variant-coordinate dataset is curated in this project; therefore no ADHD variant-domain distribution was created and no ADHD variant was placed on ANK2.
interpretation: The ADHD signal cannot be localized to a residue or domain; any claim of residue-level ADHD localization would exceed the evidence.
limitation: This is a deliberate constraint; it caps all ADHD domain claims at gene/network level.
